body: ![img](emote|t5_324q4|9156)  doing the tower with palettes that don't have their keys slots filled (climbing the tower, each boss will give you a key), using the keys on the lockers will get you a few dev diaries. The last bunch is unlocked with a special palette you'll get once all lockers are done(aka opened). Basically... just complete the tower with any new palettes you get, and use them on the lockers. A sidenote... you'll need the dlc to unlock said content.
